displayName: OCI-API-016: API — Broken Access Control on API Keys
description:
Detects API key usage from unauthorized sources or with excessive permissions

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

conditions.value: api — broken access control on api keys

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_general_api_016", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%api%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%broken%') AND "value" > 0
